title: 24" Microwave Drawer
sub: Stainless steel, automatic drawer, hidden touch controls
lead: Sharp's Microwave Drawer oven goes below the counter, in an island, or under a wall oven, and opens itself at the press of a button. The controls stay hidden in the top edge until they drop down at a 45° angle, and sensor settings handle the cooking and reheating.

features.name: Opens at the press of a button
features.line: One press and the drawer slides out on its own. A soft nudge sends it closed again.

features.name: Controls out of sight
features.line: The touch panel sits hidden in the top edge and drops down at a 45° angle when you need it, with an easy-to-read display.

features.name: Sensor cooking
features.line: Twelve sensor settings for cooking, reheating and popcorn, with two automatic reheat settings and six for defrosting.

features.name: Room for the casserole
features.line: 1.2 cubic feet inside: a 4-quart casserole dish fits, and so does a 20-ounce mug.

features.name: Where the kitchen needs it
features.line: Below an island, a peninsula or standard cabinets, or under a wall oven. Install it standard, or flush with Sharp's flush-mount kit, sold separately.

also: Sharp's under-counter pedestal (SKMD24U0ES), in stainless steel or ready for a custom panel, sold separately
specs: Touchpad that drops down at 45°; LCD, white on black
1 year parts and labor, in-home (limited); magnetron tube, 4 more years, parts only

sources.photos: Sharp's web pictures, from supplier-digital-assets/sharp (two for this model), trimmed and converted to web sizes in product-photos/SMD2470ASY. They are 1,500 pixels wide, so the largest size is the trimmed original, not 1,600.
differences: Closing: the sheet says a soft nudge closes it; Sharp's page says hands-free close. The page follows the sheet.

Flush mounting: the sheet's first page also says 'built-in airflow control for flush installation', but its table says the flush-mount kit is sold separately and names it (SKMD24F0AS). The page follows the table.
Power levels: the sheet's table prints '00'. Left off.
leftOut: 'One of the most trusted brands in microwaves' (Sharp's page) and 'the original inventor' (an infographic): no basis given
A viewing window: the photos show a dark glass front, but neither the sheet nor Sharp's page says it is a window, so the page does not claim one
ADA: the sheet's footnote only says the drawer must be installed to ADA guidelines
Sharp's note on capacity: measured at the cavity's full width, depth and height; the room for food is less
Installation manual: the one on file (SMD2470AS_SMD3070AS_IM.pdf, 2020) is for the earlier SMD2470AS, so it is not linked
sources.note: Facts from Sharp's spec sheet and product page; wording is Wilson's own. Price and stock are never kept here: the page takes them from the live shop catalog.
